code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    marks=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5]
    def neighbors(m):
        r,c=m
        return [(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(len(g)) for j in range(len(g[0]))
                if g[i][j] and (i,j)!=m and abs(i-r)<=3 and abs(j-c)<=4]
    src=max(marks,key=lambda m:len(neighbors(m)))
    dst=next(m for m in marks if m!=src)
    dr,dc=dst[0]-src[0],dst[1]-src[1]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    for r,c,v in neighbors(src):
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
            g[rr][cc]=v
    g[dst[0]][dst[1]]=0
    return g
'''
